LOOK: Transport and progressive groups assemble at Welcome Rotonda in Quezon City to stage a transport strike amid the rise in fuel prices brought by ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

The groups will march to Mendiola and Malacañang to demand the scrapping of fuel excise taxes, the removal of value-added tax (VAT), the repeal of the Oil Deregulation Law, and the nationalization of the oil industry. @ABSCBNNews
